title: Overlap: the feature is already merged

checks.name: the ledger records the overlap, naming #7 and its commit
checks.detail: #7 named: true; commit bf3ea09 named: true

checks.name: the owner is told about #7
checks.detail: the chat or a question names #7

reasons: The harness found #7 at intake, before any step started, and told the owner plainly that replace (via POST /configs), both buttons and the accounts link were already merged.
It named the real gap: remove calls DELETE /configs/:key and deletes the whole integration, label and settings included. It also warned the owner not to use that button for now.
It proposed a narrow follow-up ('Narrow it'), offered Close and Build-anyway options, and did not start rebuilding the feature.
It counted both credential endpoints as missing work instead of noting that replace never needed PUT. That makes the narrow scope a little wider than the actual gap.
Its claims about #7 match the facts. The point about the link landing at the top of the page was labelled as speculative and unconfirmed.
